brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces SPIKE_CLASH: addDrawer and addSpike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 both refused when the other occupies it. Tested both orders — each returns SPIKE_CLASH. Built closest allowed: piece:0,0,0;half-n hosts drawer:0#0,0#cut (south face cut of that cell) and spike:0#0,-1|0,0|1,-1 (south junction of same cell), one edge away, touching same cell but not same corner. Spike at exact same corner has no socket while drawer is present (find_sockets=0).

finish.summary: Exact same-corner drawer+spike is prohibited by configurator (SPIKE_CLASH). Verified bidirectionally. Built the nearest feasible alternative: both parts on the same half cell (0,0,0 half-n) with one edge between them, plus caps and joint bolts, mesh clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
